title: Engineering page: add formbook to MR !27
description:
Add formbook to the Engineering page on this branch (feat/engineering-backfill, which is MR !27, dot-7aswye). It was left out because we thought it wasn't public. It IS public: https://github.com/davidawad/formbook (GPL-3.0, verified through the GitHub API). Description from the repo: "Open formbook of court filing templates (typst + latex) for markdown-first litigators, organized by CourtListener court id".

Add an entry in src/data/engineering.ts (plus the matching engineering-i18n.ts strings for every locale the file has), following the exact shape of the other backfilled entries: name, description, link to the GitHub repo, license GPL-3.0, tags such as legal / typst / latex. Read the formbook README in the repo for accurate facts (you can fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davidawad/formbook/HEAD/README.md). Make no claims beyond what the README supports. If the MR description or any doc in this branch says formbook was excluded as non-public, update it.

Run the project's checks (yarn build, vitest, and whichever Playwright tests cover the Engineering page). Wait for the installs and builds to finish. Commit with "feat(engineering): add formbook (public, GPL-3.0) (dot-7aswye)". Don't merge or deploy.
